---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a user-tested improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem
Who needs this, and what is currently difficult?

## Suggested improvement
Describe the expected interaction and simplest viable behavior.

## Evidence
Provide public references or anonymized, consented examples if relevant.

## Engineering assumptions
Does the feature introduce new battery formulas, unit conversions, safety or privacy risks?

## Test strategy
How would a contributor know this feature works, including on mobile or with keyboard only?
